name: sun-arc
title: Sun position and daylight left
summary: A sunrise-to-sunset arc: the time of day normalised between two exported times places the sun on a pathExpression arc, a second arc traces the daylight so far, a step mask dims the sun at night, and the daylight left is formatted as "3 h 32 min".
prompt: A daylight widget: an arc from sunrise to sunset with the sun at its current position, the part of the day already gone highlighted, sunrise and sunset times, the current time and how much daylight is left.
teaches: Normalise the clock between two times with one named expression: t = clamp(0, 1, (timeInMin() − @rise) / (@set − @rise))
Place a point on an elliptical arc with x = cx − rx·cos(t·π), y = cy − ry·sin(t·π), and draw the elapsed part as a pathExpression whose angle is scaled by @t
Mask day and night with step(@now, @rise) * (1 − step(@now, @set)) and use it for the sun's alpha and halo
Format minutes as "h min" with floor(m / 60) and m % 60 joined by nested textMerge
pitfalls: Scale the angle inside expressionX/Y (cos(a[0] * @t)) and keep the pathExpression's start and end constant: the elapsed arc then always has its full sample count, however short it is
max(0, @set − @now) keeps the remaining time from going negative after sunset
clamp takes (min, max, value): the value is LAST, clamp(x, 0, 1) is always 0 (it is min(max(a, c), b), so only the max has to be in the middle)
A device reader refuses an expression longer than 32 RPN tokens (numbers, variables, operators and functions each count); split a long formula into named resources.variables

A canvas drawn at its header size (literal coordinates) runs off a narrower host and leaves a strip in a wider one: when the drawing is one composition (chart and legend, dial and readout), scale it as a whole with @fit = min(componentWidth() / W, componentHeight() / H) and centre it with a translate

snippets.note: the elapsed arc: cos/sin of a[0] * @t
the sun at angle @t * π on the arc
"3 h 32 min of daylight left" from floor(m / 60) and m % 60
the full arc as a pathExpression, 0..π

check.describe: At 14:42: the yellow arc runs from the left end past the top, the sun sits on it two thirds of the way across, and the title reads "3 h 32 min of daylight left". At 21:00 the sun sits dimmed at the sunset end with 0 h 0 min. Resized, the arc, the sun and the labels are scaled as one (@fit = min(w / 360, h / 210)) and centred: smaller at 234 wide, centred at 1:1 in a 540 wide box, the sun at the same point of its path.
